subject: FinSecure: security activity observed — request for IR plan and artifact package
messages:
From: Anika Shah <anika.shah@finsecure.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: security_ops@finsecure.com
Date: Mon, 11 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Observed unusual activity on FinSecure account — request for IR plan and artifacts

Hi Rachel,

We observed unusual API request patterns from our Redwood environment between 2028-06-10 22:30 UTC and 2028-06-11 02:00 UTC that triggered our telemetry alerts. No confirmed data exfiltration, but we need to satisfy our internal risk committee.

Could you please do the following by EOD Thursday (2028-06-14):

- Share Redwood's Incident Response Plan (IRP) or relevant sections applicable to customer-facing incidents (SOC 2 / SIG / CAIQ mapping appreciated)
- Provide a sanitized sample of S3 access logs and token/usage telemetry for the window (redacted PII ok)
- Supply a control mapping showing which SOC 2 controls / SIG questions / CAIQ rows map to the controls exercised during the event
- Confirm retention windows for raw telemetry and audit logs (we have a 90-day requirement for forensic evidence)

We can accept a secure Drive share or SFTP. Please confirm lead contact for the package and estimated delivery time.

Attaching our incident intake template for reference: FinSecure_IR_Intake_Template.pdf (stub)

Thanks,

Anika Shah
Sr. Security Engineer
FinSecure
anika.shah@finsecure.com
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.inference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Anika Shah <anika.shah@finsecure.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Jun 2028 09:45:12 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Observed unusual activity on FinSecure account — request for IR plan and artifacts

Team — forwarding FinSecure's ask. They want an IR package and SOC2/SIG/CAIQ mapping by EOD Thu 2028-06-14.

Anika copied security_ops@finsecure.com. Can you confirm owners and what artifacts we can provide (sanitized logs, telemetry extracts, control mapping)? Also call out any constraints (redaction needs, retention policy limits).

I'll be the customer lead on this thread; please loop legal if we need any CPNAs or NDAs.

Attachments: incident_acknowledgement.txt (stub)

Thanks,
Rachel

Date: Mon, 11 Jun 2028 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Observed unusual activity on FinSecure account — request for IR plan and artifacts

Thanks Rachel / Anika.

We will assemble the package. High-level plan and owners below:

- Marissa Cole (Security) — overall package owner; will provide SOC 2 control mapping and SIG/CAIQ crosswalk (deliverable: sig_caiaq_control_map.xlsx)
- Karthik Iyer (Infra) — generate sanitized telemetry and S3 access logs sample (deliverables: s3_access_logs_sample_20280611.gz; redwood_ir_timeline.csv)
- Jonas Weber (Engineering) — produce a short timeline and containment notes; include any temporary mitigations applied during window

Proposed timeline:
- 2028-06-12 18:00 UTC — initial evidence package (sanitized logs + timeline)
- 2028-06-13 12:00 UTC — SOC2/SIG/CAIQ mapping and control notes
- 2028-06-14 17:00 UTC — final, signed package and retention confirmation

Constraints / notes:
- We will redact IP addresses and any customer PII per our policy; if FinSecure requires raw PII we will need a signed data sharing agreement. (Please advise.)
- Retention: Redwood retains raw telemetry for 120 days; derived aggregates for 2 years. We will provide the export requested within those windows.

Sharing method: we'll put artifacts in a secure Drive folder and share with FinSecure's security@finsecure.com address. If you prefer SFTP, let us know and we'll provision a short-lived account.

Attachments planned: sig_caiaq_control_map.xlsx; s3_access_logs_sample_20280611.gz; redwood_ir_timeline.csv

I'll start the export now and update with links.

—Marissa
Director, Security
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.inference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Anika Shah <anika.shah@finsecure.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jun 2028 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence exports / retention confirmation for FinSecure

Update on technical side:

- Sanitization: We'll strip object keys, full account ids and PII, replace with stable pseudonyms. Hash seeds documented in redwood_ir_timeline.csv.
- Logs: We will export S3 access logs and application request logs for the window 2028-06-10 22:00 UTC — 2028-06-11 03:00 UTC. Sample will be gzipped and SHA256 checksummed.
- Retention confirmation: Raw telemetry retained 120 days (per Marissa). We can produce a forensics export on request within that period. For longer-term retention, we can arrange an escrow export; legal & procurement will need to sign-off.

Drive link (temporary, expires 2028-06-20): https://drive.redwood.example/FinSecure/IR-Package-2028-06-15

I'll upload the first artifacts by 2028-06-12 18:00 UTC.

-Karthik
Senior Infra Engineer
From: Anika Shah <anika.shah@finsecure.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Jun 2028 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Observed unusual activity on FinSecure account — request for IR plan and artifacts

Thanks all — we received the Drive share and have started reviewing the artifacts. The initial package looks good and we appreciate the pseudonymization.

Next steps from our side:
- Our forensics team will review the logs and get back with any follow-up questions by 2028-06-18
- If we need unlabeled data for correlation, we'll request a formal data sharing agreement

FinSecure accepts the proposed retention confirmation for now. We'll follow up if escrow is necessary.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

-Anika
